_comment: Single source of truth for OpenAI model ids. Read by src/config/ai.ts, netlify/functions/_responses.js and supabase/functions/_shared/openai.ts (keep supabase copy in sync; a unit test checks it). Ids per https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models. Override any role at runtime with SMARTCRM_<ROLE>_MODEL / SMARTCRM_<ROLE>_EFFORT env vars (server side).
